intro.en: Read formal correspondence, follow its purpose and conditions, and recognise cautious wording.

titulo.en: Read the purpose and the conditions

texto.en: Formal messages often follow a predictable path: identify the matter, explain the decision or next step, list any conditions, and close politely. Expressions such as **en relación con**, **se ha recibido** and **quedamos a su disposición** signal a formal register. Pay attention to what the writer promises and what is still pending. A conditional such as **podría** may soften a proposal; it does not necessarily confirm that the action will happen. In the fictional message below, the thirty-day review period is invented for practice; actual deadlines depend on the service and applicable rules. The examples practise reading formal correspondence and do not replace an actual contract or official decision.

frases.es: En relación con la reclamación que presentó el 4 de mayo por la cancelación de su viaje, le confirmamos que hemos recibido el formulario y el justificante de pago.
frases.en: Regarding the complaint you submitted on 4 May about the cancellation of your trip, we confirm that we have received the form and proof of payment.

frases.es: En este ejemplo ficticio, la documentación se ha remitido al departamento correspondiente, que dispone de un plazo interno de treinta días para revisar el expediente.
frases.en: In this fictional example, the documents have been sent to the relevant department, which has an internal period of thirty days to review the case.

frases.es: Si fuera necesario aportar algún dato adicional, nos pondríamos en contacto con usted por correo electrónico.
frases.en: If it were necessary to provide any additional information, we would contact you by email.

frases.es: Una vez concluida la revisión, le comunicaremos la decisión y, si procede, le explicaremos cómo se calculará el reembolso.
frases.en: Once the review is complete, we will inform you of the decision and, if applicable, explain how the refund will be calculated.

frases.es: Esta respuesta confirma la recepción de su reclamación, pero no implica que se haya aprobado el reembolso.
frases.en: This reply confirms receipt of your complaint, but it does not mean that the refund has been approved.

frases.es: Quedamos a su disposición para cualquier consulta y le saludamos atentamente.
frases.en: We remain available for any questions and send our kind regards.

It has received the complaint and docume.en: The message confirms receipt, not the outcome.

It has approved the refund.en: The final decision is still pending.

bloques.correcta: It has received the complaint and documents

If it is appropriate or applicable.en: The refund explanation depends on the review.

Because the refund is guaranteed.en: The text does not guarantee a refund.

bloques.correcta: If it is appropriate or applicable

pregunta.en: Complete: regarding the complaint you submitted…

En relación con.en: A formal way to introduce the matter.

pregunta.en: Why does the writer use «nos pondríamos en contacto»?

It presents a possible future step polit.en: The contact depends on whether more information is needed.

It says the agency already contacted her.en: The conditional does not report a completed action.

It confirms that the case is closed.en: The review is still in progress.

bloques.correcta: It presents a possible future step politely

bloques.frase: Quedamos a su disposición para cualquier consulta

traduccion.en: We remain available for any questions.
